name: Adversarial Isolation Verification
description: Prove that extension memory isolation cannot be bypassed through injection, timing, or side channels. Comprehensive security verification of the isolation boundary.
purpose: Provide cryptographic guarantee that extension memory isolation is inviolable — no extension can access another's memory through any vector including direct API calls, injection attacks, timing side channels, or covert storage channels.
acceptanceCriteria: Direct access verification: extension A cannot read extension B's bank through any API
Injection verification: SQL/NoSQL injection cannot cross bank boundaries
Timing side-channel verification: no timing oracle leaks information about other banks
Covert channel verification: no shared storage or IPC used to exfiltrate cross-extension
Capability bypass verification: no operation bypasses capability check
Verification suite is automated and runs in CI
Verification results are published as a security attestation
rollback_strategy: N/A — verification only, no state to roll back
recovery_strategy: Re-run verification suite from clean test environment
